cases.estimand: Static template-density values evaluated by nearest-grid lookup along the fast constant-step focal fixation trajectory at requested times and optionally aggregated into bins.
conventions: cut(right=FALSE): every bin is half-open, including the last; measure the final endpoint explicitly
control means are formed per time before bin aggregation
missing trajectory or template support retained
cases.independent_case: Exact onset steps, asymmetric nearest-grid lookup, finite occurrence selection and two-stage bin arithmetic; nested partial-control mean 11/3 versus pooled 4.
cases.divergence: Four normalization modes, unsorted/repeated queries, the half-open final bin, the held final fixation, distinct-template controls and exhaustive controls match independently checked reference values under HalfOpen and HoldLastOnset. Native retains unmatched/ambiguous/duplicate source errors instead of dropped rows or first-match selection; uses explicit clock/frame identities and keyed finite selection rather than R RNG; disallows nonfinite template cells. Raw R partial-cell failures remain, with nested versus pooled aggregation independently qualified. Named arithmetic recipe and complete replay-verified result persist on JVM/JS, separate from duration occupancy.
